# Code Map — Budgeting (Zero-Based Budgeting Console)

Next.js 16 / React 19, Owner/Accountant only. The design system (ui/, theme.ts,
globals.css, NavRail, HeaderClock) is a **verbatim copy of Dispatcher** — change Dispatcher
first, then re-copy; never edit the copy in place. Manifest + drift check: Budgeting/CLAUDE.md.

## Screens — Budgeting/components/screens (8 top-level)

Sub-screen folders: screens/periods/ (5)

<!-- notes:budgeting-screens:start -->
- BudgetPeriods.tsx is only the master/detail host — the period dashboard lives in screens/periods/ (PeriodList, LifecycleStepper, PlanningChecklist, one AllocationSection per code category) and shows the server's planned totals.
- Allocations.tsx shows the same real lines flat and sums its tiles client-side (it cannot refresh Console's period list); both it and the dashboard share BudgetAllocationFormModal.
- After a transition or line save, the dashboard refetches the projection until the expected state/values appear (`stateAfter`) before refreshing the period list — reads are eventually consistent.
<!-- notes:budgeting-screens:end -->

## Lib — Budgeting/lib (20 files)
<!-- gen:budgeting-lib:start -->
api/ (5): budgeting, budgeting.test, format, shared, transport
Top-level: auth, claims.test, claims, clipboard, data, format, money.test, money, nav, period, roles.test, roles, theme, types, useToday
<!-- gen:budgeting-lib:end -->
<!-- notes:budgeting-lib:start -->
- api/budgeting.ts is the real API wiring — periods (incl. the lifecycle transitions), codes AND allocations come from the backend; data.ts keeps only the mock actuals/variance (plus a budgetCodes lookup feeding those mock rows).
- money.ts holds the signed delta formatters (formatDeltaCad/formatDeltaPct) — kept out of data.ts so real-data screens never import the mock module.
<!-- notes:budgeting-lib:end -->
